mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fd_department_change_log (id, department_id, change_time, operator, field_name, field_label, old_value, new_value, tenant_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{departmentId}, #{changeTime}, #{operator}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldLabel}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{scopedTenantId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id, change_time, operator, field_name, field_label, old_value, new_value, tenant_id FROM fd_department_change_log WHERE IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND department_id = #{departmentId} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 ORDER BY change_time DESC
